notes: CRM notes: POC initiated on Hosted API to validate prompt parity w/ incumbent. Team: Eng PM (Lina), ML infra lead (Raj), Product lead (Chris). Key asks: 1) minimal prompt rework when switching - customer has ~250 curated prompts; 2) SDK compatibility so they can swap provider with config change; 3) no regression on sentiment/tone for support responses; 4) EU residency for subset of logs and model inputs. POC outcome: throughput + latency = good; cost per 1M tokens with Hosted is higher than incumbent but much better if we can commit to Dedicated. They ran A/B on 8k sessions; 2 intents fell below baseline — se to triage differences, suspect tokenization/stop behavior and system message differences. Follow-ups: emailed price deck (drive link), asked for sample logs to reproduce regressions (customer hesitates to share full logs; agreed to synthetic reproducer). Customer quote on call: 'We can't afford tone drift with customers — regressions are showstoppers.'
migration_plan_summary: Start with Redwood Hosted API as compatibility layer: map existing SDK calls to Redwood endpoints, run side-by-side A/B for 4 weeks, collect metrics (latency, relevancy, token cost). If parity achieved, move to Dedicated: reserve capacity for peak with autoscale burst, schedule canary rollout per region. Key migration tasks: prompt parity tests, system prompt canonicalization, client SDK flags for fallback, regression test suite (250 prompts), billing/pricing change management.
